title: openai-compat: add Responses API variants, seed/determinism flags, and metadata passthrough
author: Ava Martinez
release_notes: Add OpenAI Responses API variants and compatibility: passthrough of seed/determinism flags and request metadata, improved streaming stability for structured outputs. Backwards-compatible API layer changes. See docs for migration notes.
description:
Motivation: Bring Redwood's OpenAI compatibility shim up-to-date with recent Responses API variants and feature flags (seed, deterministic sampling) and make it trivial for customers to pass arbitrary request metadata that should be preserved in response payloads. This PR also fixes a streaming stability edge-case when structured output (tool/function calling) and metadata passthrough are enabled concurrently.

Summary of changes: 1) Add explicit mapping for Responses API variants (response.v1 vs responses depending on model flag) and surface a single 'responses' handler in the compat layer. 2) Pass-through 'seed' and 'deterministic' (or 'determinism') fields from upstream OpenAI requests into the runtime request metadata so seeded/deterministic runs behave end-to-end. 3) Preserve arbitrary 'metadata' and 'client_request_id' fields on response messages and in audit logs for observability. 4) Fix streaming state machine to avoid early EOF when structured output tokens contain metadata boundary markers; added unit and integration tests. 5) Docs: update /docs/openai/compat/responses.md and migration notes.

Checklist:
- [x] Compatibility layer: request/response schema mappings
- [x] Seed/determinism passthrough implemented and tested
- [x] Metadata passthrough + audit logging preserved
- [x] Streaming stability fix + tests
- [x] Integration tests against upstream OpenAI-esque harness
- [x] Docs updated

How verified: Unit tests added for new mapping logic and streaming edge-case. Integration test harness ran against local mock of OpenAI Responses API (see tests/integration/mock_responses_server.py). Ran canary on staging dedicated cluster for a subset of traffic (10k streaming requests) and observed no regressions in latency and zero incidents related to EOF streaming errors.

Notes and follow-ups: We intentionally keep older 'completions' compatibility intact; this change is additive. There's a follow-up ENG task to add telemetry counters for 'seeded' requests and to expose determinism in the Console per-route breakdown (ENG-3567). Also recommend creating a short blurb on the changelog for hosted customers explaining how to opt into deterministic/seeded responses via the OpenAI-compatible request fields.

Links: Linear: ENG-3421, ENG-3490. Related PRs: pr-55789 (streaming stability fixes), pr-59120 (responses determinism tests).
